simple.meaning: בְּאֹשׁ (bᵉʼôsh) is a Hebrew word meaning “a stench.” BibleIQ connects the English word back to this source word so its use can be compared across Scripture.
simple.biblicalBackground: בְּאֹשׁ (H889) appears 3 times in the Hebrew Bible, beginning at Isaiah 34:3, with occurrences in Isaiah, Joel, Amos.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to בְּאֹשׁ (H889) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: English translations can use the same English word for different Hebrew words. BibleIQ anchors the study in בְּאֹשׁ (H889) before moving outward to related references.
simple.summary: בְּאֹשׁ (bᵉʼôsh) / H889 is traced through Isaiah 34:3, Joel 2:20, Amos 4:10 using source-language evidence and occurrence comparison.
